description: Brother and sister team from Bahrain! We are passionate about health and data analytics. We aim to help create software that gives valuable insights to the super smart analysts of the NASA Space Agency.
summary:
For this project, we developed an interactive NASA data dashboard using Python and Streamlit. The goal was to make space-related data easier to explore and understand through simple charts, graphs, and visualizations. Instead of having to go through large amounts of raw data, users can interact with the dashboard and quickly identify patterns, trends, and interesting information.

The project uses data visualization tools like Plotly to turn complex datasets into clear and easy-to-read visuals. It addresses the challenge of making scientific data more accessible to people who may not have a technical or scientific background.

We believe this project is important because NASA collects huge amounts of data, but that information is only useful if people can understand it. By building this dashboard, we wanted to explore how technology and data visualization can make complex information easier to access, analyze, and learn from.
details:
The dashboard works by using Python to collect, organize, and process NASA-related data and then display it through interactive charts and visualizations. We used Streamlit to build the dashboard interface and Plotly to create charts that allow users to explore the data more easily. Users can interact with the dashboard, view different trends, and understand the information without needing to work directly with raw datasets.

One of the main benefits is that it saves time and makes large amounts of data easier to understand. The intended impact is to make scientific information more accessible and encourage people to become more interested in space and data.

We developed this project using Python, Streamlit, Plotly, and libraries such as Pandas and NumPy. I used Visual Studio Code as my development environment and my personal MacBook for coding and testing.

The creative part of this project is combining NASA data with an interactive dashboard instead of presenting information through static charts or long reports. During development, we considered the user experience, simplicity, readability, accuracy of the data, and how to make the dashboard useful for someone with little experience in data analysis. We wanted to create something that was both informative and easy to use.
